ValidationRule.description: For certain dispute reasons, the field 'Customer Contacted Merchant' must be Yes or No.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Card_Dispute', OR( ISPICKVAL( Dispute_Reason__c ,'Cancellation of regular payment arrangement was unsuccessful'), ISPICKVAL( Dispute_Reason__c ,'Credit has not been processed or processed incorrectly'), ISPICKVAL( Dispute_Reason__c ,'Goods or services purchased but not received'), ISPICKVAL( Dispute_Reason__c ,'Goods or services defective or not as described') ), OR( ISPICKVAL( Customer_Contacted_Merchant__c ,'NA'), ISPICKVAL( Customer_Contacted_Merchant__c ,'') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For this dispute reason, please select either Yes, No for this field.
